card.name: Which in "The degree to which" overdose
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "which" in "The degree to which hydrochlorothiazide is removed" in overdose sections. Weaker on a small linking word in instructions, such as "the", "you" or "of" after a verb or conjunction.

modes.label: Degree to which
modes.description: "which" ending the phrase "The degree to which" before hydrochlorothiazide is removed by dialysis.

modes.label: Instruction linking words
modes.description: A short word like "the", "you" or "of" in step-by-step handling or antidote instructions.
modes.example: Do not add water until<< you>> dispense.
